The silhouette and the large inner shapes (head, wing, tail) are drawn with a heavy, even, dark keyline of the same thick weight as the reference side view, so this view and the side view read as one artist's sprite set.

Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
